D: A storm chaser who lost her team comes back to Oklahoma and teams up with a YouTube tornado wrangler to try to break up a twister.
P: Bring out the funnel cakes when Tyler takes Kate to the rodeo in Stillwater.
S: Fried okra with comeback sauce for Tyler's crew, rolled in from Arkansas.

Stir the mayonnaise, chilli sauce, tomato sauce, hot sauce and a squeeze of lemon into the comeback sauce. Soak the okra in the buttermilk, then toss it in the cornmeal, flour, paprika and a big pinch of salt. Fry in batches at 180C until crisp and golden, then drain. Salt straight away and serve hot with the sauce.
Beef patties smashed thin into heaps of onion, fried crisp.

Roll the beef into 8 balls and season well. Heat a heavy pan very hot, add a ball, pile on a handful of onions and smash flat through the onions with a spatula. Cook until the edges crust, flip so the onions fry underneath, and lay on a slice of cheese. Toast the buttered buns, then build with pickle and mustard and serve hot.
M: Crumbed steak fried crisp with cream gravy and mash. Kate goes home to her mum's farm.

Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with the butter and a splash of the milk. Season the flour with garlic powder, pepper and salt; whisk the eggs with the buttermilk. Dip the steaks in flour, egg, then flour again, pressing it on well. Shallow-fry in hot oil until deep golden, about 3 minutes a side, and drain. Pour off all but 2 tbsp of oil, whisk in 2 tbsp flour, then the rest of the milk, and simmer into a peppery gravy. Wilt the silverbeet and serve with the steak, mash and gravy.
150g plain flour, plus 2 tbsp for the gravy@Pantry
Paprika-rubbed brisket smoked low, in soft rolls. Riggs buys up the storm-wrecked land.

Rub the brisket all over with the paprika, sugar, garlic powder and salt. Sit it in a roasting dish with the stock, cover tightly and cook at 150C until it pulls apart. Rest, then slice or shred and toss with the barbecue sauce and some of the pan juices. Mix the cabbage, carrot, jalapenos, mayo and vinegar into a slaw. Pile the brisket and slaw into the rolls.
W: Funnel cakes fried crisp with icing sugar and strawberries. A night at the Stillwater rodeo.

Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar, eggs, milk and vanilla into a smooth pouring batter. Heat the oil to 180C in a wide pan. Pour a cup of batter through a funnel or a squeeze bottle in a loose swirl and fry until golden, turning once. Drain, dust heavily with icing sugar and top with strawberries.
K: Fresh lemonade with bourbon over ice. Tyler says if you feel it, chase it.
Stir the lemon juice and sugar until dissolved, then add the water. Fill 4 jars with ice, add 40ml bourbon each, top with lemonade and a mint sprig.
